# Zeyn Framework

> Rust web framework for data heavy applications. Screens are rendered on the server; AI agents write the app code and people review it.

- [Agent rules and framework index](crates/zeyn-cli/templates/AGENTS.md.tmpl): macros, types, screens, actions, recipes in one page
- [Language example](docs/language-example.md): a full feature written with Zeyn
- [Runtime protocol](docs/runtime-protocol.md): how the browser runtime talks to the server
- [Theming](docs/theming.md): design tokens
- MCP: run `zeyn mcp` in a project for docs, checks and tests as tools
